data.narrative:
DefSecIntel is a Series A-stage frontier-tech company in the Defense & Security sector. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable set of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Peer-median methodology was applied across the 10-company comp set, yielding a median valuation of $1.0B. The peer range spans $125M to $3.0B, with notable comparables including Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), Harmattan AI at $1.4B (Series B), Code Metal at $1.2B (Series B), and both Castelion and Defense Unicorns at $1.0B (Series B). The concentration of Series B valuations in the $1.0B–$1.4B range suggests moderate stage-discount applied to DefSecIntel's Series A positioning.

The triangulation analysis, constrained by single-method applicability, supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.1B, with a median of $1.0B. Key uncertainties include DefSecIntel's specific revenue traction, burn profile relative to peers, and differentiation within a crowded defense-AI landscape. The absence of disclosed raise amount limits stage-specific calibration. This range reflects peer comparability but should be refined with operating metrics and market positioning data.
